public_rationale: Meta's reported revenue growth slowed between the second and third quarters of 2026, satisfying the antecedent under the stated reading. The evidence does not establish the predicted cut to loss-making generative AI. Meta's investment outlook points against an immediate retreat, but aggregate spending plans cannot settle the specific cost claim. With no deadline, the forecast remains open.
limitations: Revenue growth is an evaluator-selected interpretation of growth.
The spending claim lacks an accounting basis and separately reported financial measures.
Investment guidance describes plans rather than realized spending.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: At some point growth will slow at one of the Magnificent 7, forcing it to cut money-losing costs such as generative AI.
conditions: when growth slows at one of the Magnificent 7

statement.excerpt: There are limited amounts of capital, but also limited amounts of data centers to actually put GPUs, and on top of that, at some point growth will slow at one of the Magnificent 7, at which point costs will have to come down from things that lose them tons of money, such as generative AI.
statement.document_title: The Hater's Guide To The AI Bubble

from_speaker: growth will slow at one of the Magnificent 7
costs will have to come down
our_interpretation: Read growth slowdown as a decline in a company's reported year-over-year revenue growth rate between successive quarters after publication.
The predicted consequence is a reduction in spending on loss-making generative AI caused by that slowdown. General layoffs or reductions in unrelated spending do not suffice.
No deadline, minimum slowdown, spending measure, or accounting basis is supplied.
criteria.support_condition: A qualifying slowdown followed by documented reductions in loss-making generative-AI spending, with credible evidence linking those reductions to the slowdown.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Decisive evidence that the asserted necessity fails. Continued spending for a finite period after a slowdown weighs against the mechanism but cannot conclusively refute an eventual forecast with no deadline.

evidence.locator: Second Quarter 2026 Operational and Other Financial Highlights, Revenue
evidence.explanation: Provides the preceding quarter's reported revenue growth rate for comparison with e2. This establishes only part of the slowdown condition.

evidence.locator: Third Quarter 2026 Operational and Other Financial Highlights, Revenue; CFO Outlook Commentary
evidence.explanation: Growth slowed from the 28% reported in e1 to 26%, meeting the chosen antecedent. As countervailing context, the release raises the lower end of annual capital-spending guidance and anticipates aggressive AI investment; neither measure isolates realized generative-AI spending.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Comparable evidence of generative-AI losses and spending reductions, together with a documented link to a qualifying growth slowdown and a defensible accounting scope.
